Counsel for Applicant :- Krishna Kumar Chaurasia Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Om Prakash,Pankaj Sharma Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in S.T. No. 23 of 2020, Case Crime No. 0121 of 2019 at Police Station- Chilh, District- Mirzapur under Sections 498A,
304B, IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 22.10.2019.
The second bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 02.06.2020.

The following arguments made by Shri Krishna Kumar Chaurasia, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
One child was born in the wedlock.
The applicant had harmonious relations with his wife.

sentences.text: 2. The applicant never harassed the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
3. The applicant is bereaved by the death of his wife.
4. The deceased died of natural causes.
5. The postmortem report opines that cause of death could not be ascertained.
There are no antemortem injuries on the person of the deceased.
6. The applicant was nominated at the instigation of interested parties for extorting money.
7. The viscera report has not been produced.
8. The applicant is a law abiding citizen who cooperated with the police investigations and has joined the trial.
9. The trial is moving at a snail's pace and and shows no sign of early conclusion.
The applicant cannot be faulted for the delay in the trial.
10. Inordinate delay in concluding trial has lead to virtually an indefinite imprisonment of the applicant, without any evidence.
11. The right of the applicant to speedy trial has been violated.
12. Status report sent by the learned trial court records that as per the chargesheet twenty witnesses are proposed to be examined.
However, only two witness has been examined till date.
13. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
14. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Udal Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
